samples.claim: Private apply_range_segments returns Ok immediately unless destination manifest enables conversion. If current manifest also enables it, build HashMap fragment ID to starting raw byte pointer for only inline row-ID entries; otherwise empty. Duplicate IDs overwrite earlier pointer entries. Equality later is ID plus pointer, not encoded-content digest or bytes. Raw pointers are compared, never dereferenced; no unsafe block.

82 | /// Re-encode inline row id sequences as runs of `Range` segments when the
83 | /// table has opted in.
84 | ///
85 | /// Fragments that the previous manifest already re-encoded are left alone
86 | /// (their inline bytes are the very same allocation), so a commit pays only
87 | /// for the fragments it changed; enabling the key re-encodes every fragment
88 | /// once.
89 | fn apply_range_segments(
90 |     manifest: &mut Manifest,
91 |     current_manifest: Option<&Manifest>,
92 | ) -> Result<()> {
93 |     if !range_segments_enabled(manifest) {
94 |         return Ok(());
95 |     }
96 |     let unchanged: HashMap<u64, *const u8> = current_manifest
97 |         .filter(|current| range_segments_enabled(current))
98 |         .map(|current| {
99 |             current
100 |                 .fragments
101 |                 .iter()
102 |                 .filter_map(|fragment| match &fragment.row_id_meta {
103 |                     Some(RowIdMeta::Inline(data)) => Some((fragment.id, data.as_ptr())),
104 |                     _ => None,
105 |                 })
106 |                 .collect()

108 |         .unwrap_or_default();

samples.claim: Writer-prepared v2 fields have fixed order kind:UInt8, data:LargeBinary, uri:Utf8, blob_id:UInt32, blob_size:UInt64, position:UInt64, all nullable. Comments distinguish Inline carrying data, Packed carrying id/position/size, Dedicated carrying id/size with position0, and External carrying URI, optional id and range information. External blob_size0 denotes whole-object length resolved on read. blob_size prevents confusion with logical range size; stored descriptor renames uri to blob_uri. BLOB_V2_PREPARED_TYPE is the Struct of these fields; runtime routing/length resolution is not implemented here.
samples.evidence:
83 | 
84 | /// Writer-prepared blob v2 fields consumed by the structural encoder.
85 | ///
86 | /// The populated fields depend on [`BlobKind`]:
87 | ///
88 | /// - [`BlobKind::Inline`] carries `data`; the encoder derives the stored
89 | ///   `position` and `size` from the out-of-line buffer it creates.
90 | /// - [`BlobKind::Packed`] carries `blob_id`, `position`, and `blob_size`.
91 | /// - [`BlobKind::Dedicated`] carries `blob_id` and `blob_size`; its stored
92 | ///   `position` is zero.
93 | /// - [`BlobKind::External`] carries `uri`, optional `blob_id`, `position`, and
94 | ///   `blob_size`. A zero `blob_size` is resolved to the complete external object
95 | ///   length when read.
96 | ///
97 | /// `blob_size` is distinct from the logical `size`, which is only an optional
98 | /// external-object range before preparation. For external blobs, `uri` is
99 | /// normalized into the stable stored `blob_uri` field.
100 | pub static BLOB_V2_PREPARED_FIELDS: LazyLock<Fields> = LazyLock::new(|| {
101 |     Fields::from(vec![
102 |         ArrowField::new("kind", DataType::UInt8, true),
103 |         ArrowField::new("data", DataType::LargeBinary, true),
104 |         ArrowField::new("uri", DataType::Utf8, true),
105 |         ArrowField::new("blob_id", DataType::UInt32, true),
106 |         ArrowField::new("blob_size", DataType::UInt64, true),
107 |         ArrowField::new("position", DataType::UInt64, true),
108 |     ])
109 | });
110 | 
111 | /// The writer-prepared blob v2 struct type.
112 | pub static BLOB_V2_PREPARED_TYPE: LazyLock<DataType> =
113 |     LazyLock::new(|| DataType::Struct(BLOB_V2_PREPARED_FIELDS.clone()));

samples.claim: If segment has more remaining values than requested, slice requested ordinal range, extend output and keep current segment with increased offset. Adjacent plain output ranges may merge through extend.
